observer_contract.base_vector_boundary: Capture RCX at 0x14136f750 entry and sample after return, or capture RSI at 0x141371d1c. Validate the view vtable and use a fail-closed opening/header/items/closing double-read.
observer_contract.dynamic_boundary: Use 0x14137a780 completion for a full state refresh and retain per-item 0x141379a50/0x1413778f0 observations for the same view, country, thread, and frame hour.
transient_joins: Join highlight events by authenticated item pointer, then replace the pointer with focus_definition+0x18 id before serialization.
Join display-percent events by authenticated detail_object+0xf50 definition pointer.
Join joint-view country identity inside 0x141379a50 to the same item pointer; zero is measured hidden, not missing.
observer_contract.atomicity: Commit only after the vector header, pointer array, item vtables, definition pointers, state leaves, frame hour, country, and all required transient leaves remain stable and refer to one observation epoch.
observer_contract.failure: Any missing hook leaf, pointer reuse, count/capacity mismatch, duplicate definition id, cross-country join, cross-hour join, or unsupported state rejects the whole A31 frame.
